info.name: eManager HRM - Salary Configuration CRUD
info.description:
Run this collection against your local development database. It creates disposable salary fixtures and deletes them in dependency order at the end.

Set login_email, login_password, and employee_id locally before running. Use an active email-login account with view, add, change, and delete grants for all four salary models. Do not share saved credentials.

Leave the cookie jar enabled. Use the same base_url host for all requests and omit the trailing slash.

Choose an existing active test employee and a date range where the employee has no compensation assignment. Change effective_from and effective_to if the defaults overlap.

Run all folders in order. When sending individual requests, start with the two session requests and create related records before referencing their captured IDs.
